double meanAbsoluteDeviation(List<double> numbers) {
  if (numbers.isEmpty) return 0.0;
  
  double mean = numbers.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / numbers.length;
  List<double> deviations = [];
  
  for (var num in numbers) {
    deviations.add(abs(num - mean));
  }
  
  return deviations.reduce((a, b) => a + b) / numbers.length;
}

List<int> parseNestedParens(String parenString) {
  int index = 0;
  List<int> results = [];
  
  void process(int depth, int start) {
    if (index >= parenString.length || parenString[index] != '(') return;
    
    ++index; // Skip '('
    int count = 1;
    int currentDepth = depth + 1;
    
    while (index < parenString.length && count > 0) {
      if (parenString[index] == '(') {
        ++count;
      } else if (parenString[index] == ')') {
        --count;
      }
      
      if (count == 0) break;
      ++index;
    }

    if (count == 0) {
      if (currentDepth == 1) {
        results.add(index - start);
      } else {
        process(currentDepth, start);
      }
    } else {
      process(currentDepth, start); // No matching closing parenthesis
    }
  }
  
  process(0, 0);
  return results;
}

List<double> rescaleToUnit(List<double> numbers) {
  if (numbers.isEmpty) return [];
  
  double min = numbers.reduce(min);
  double max = numbers.reduce(max);
  double range = max - min;
  
  if (range == 0.0) {
    return List.filled(numbers.length, 0.0);
  }
  
  return numbers.map((num) => (num - min) / range).toList();
}

bool isPrime(int n) {
  if (n <= 1) return false;
  if (n == 2 || n == 3) return true;
  if (n % 2 == 0 || n % 3 == 0) return false;

  for (int i = 5; i * i <= n; i += 6) {
    if (n % i == 0 || n % (i + 2) == 0) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  return true;
}

  List<int> indices = List<int>.filled(n, 0);
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    indices[i] = i;

  void swap(int a, int b) {
    final temp = indices[a];
    indices[a] = indices[b];
    indices[b] = temp;

  void bubbleSort() {
    for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
      for (int j = 0; j < n - i - 1; j++) {
        if (indices[j] > indices[j + 1]) {
          swap(j, j + 1);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  for (var index in indices) {
    result += s[index];
  }
  
  return result;
}

int xOrY(int n, int x, int y) {
  if (n < 0 || n > 1000000) return -1;
  
  List<int> nums = [];
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if ((i & x) != 0 && (i & y) == 0) {
      nums.add(i);
    }
  }

  var sum = 0;
  for (var num in nums) {
    sum += num;
  }

  return sum;
}

import 'dart:math';

int doubleTheDifference(List<num> lst) {
  if (lst.isEmpty || lst.length < 2) return 0;
  
  num maxVal = -inf;
  num minVal = inf;
  
  for (var i in lst) {
    if (i > maxVal) maxVal = i;
    if (i < minVal) minVal = i;
  }
  
  var difference = maxVal - minVal;
  var doubledDiff = 2 * difference;
  return doubledDiff.toInt();
}

String findMax(List<String> words) {
  int maxIndex = 0;
  for (int i = 1; i < words.length; i++) {
    if (words[i].length > words[maxIndex].length) {
      maxIndex = i;
    }
  }
  return words[maxIndex];
}
